title: Does Well‑Done Steak Lose Protein?

scenes.text: What happens to protein when you grill a steak to 165°F?
People say a well‑done steak has far less protein than a medium‑rare one.
scenes.label: Well‑done loses protein

scenes.text: Scientific analysis shows cooking only changes water content; total protein stays virtually the same, just slightly less digestible at very high temperatures.
scenes.label: Protein stays mostly intact

scenes.text: Choose doneness for taste, not protein.
scenes.label: Taste > protein myth
scenes.sub: Protein loss is minimal, focus on flavor and safety.
scenes.query2: how cooking level affects steak flavor

description: Many worry that cooking steak well kills its protein power. The truth is it barely changes. Choose how you like it and stay fueled. Follow for more practical nutrition insights.
